title: Craft Blend 2-Mix Solo #21 (가로 띠 3구역·매끈)
prompt:
Image format: a vertical portrait-orientation photograph, 2:3 aspect ratio, taller than it is wide.

A full-body photograph with a plain seamless deep-charcoal backdrop, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/8, a single hard key light raking in from one side, sharp focus from head to toe, realistic photographic grain — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

Subject: ONE real adult Ukrainian woman in her late 40s, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, fair, luminous skin, round warm red blush high on the cheeks, dark strongly defined straight brows, soft brown eyeshadow, long lashes, large blue-grey eyes with bright real catchlights, a natural deep rose lip, and a wreath of real red poppies, blue cornflowers and wheat ears sitting on top of the head, a warm, calm expression, cheerful, cool ash-brown hair styled in a classic French braid from the crown, real living eyes. Long round nails, matte finish.

Physique: An extraordinarily tall and enormous woman, far beyond any real person, towering and broad. A commanding, statuesque frame with huge broad shoulders, powerful thick arms with hard defined muscle, a strong deep chest, and a long, dense, muscular torso with only a slight inward taper at the waist. Enormous powerful hips and colossal long thighs with hard muscle visible through a soft layer, thick strong calves. Not slim, not delicate, powerful, statuesque and imposing. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.

Skin: Real photographic skin — visible pores and fine grain, a smooth taut surface with natural creases and shadow only where the flesh folds. No smooth illustration finish, no plastic CG sheen.

Body Art: Her bare skin is painted with 2 different traditional patterns repeated across 3 regions of her figure. Her figure is divided into 3 horizontal bands by 2 hazy transition zones centred about 22% of the way down her figure from the top and about 73% of the way down her figure from the top. The regions alternate between 2 patterns in a repeating order. Region 1 is everything above the first transition zone: it is painted in Portuguese azulejo tile (a brilliant white ground with deep cobalt-blue floral borders), wide cobalt bands following the contours of the body, with repeating panel scrollwork filling the space between bands. Region 2 is the band between transition zone 1 and transition zone 2: it is painted in American Art Deco chrome-and-lacquer (a deep black lacquer ground with bold silver chrome sunburst), wide silver chrome bands following the contours of the body, with zigzag linework filling the space between bands. Region 3 is everything below the last transition zone: it is painted in the same pattern as Region 1. The boundaries between regions are hazy and feathered — there is no visible line at all. Each transition zone is about a hand's width wide, and across it the neighbouring patterns dissolve into each other, motifs from one thinning out as motifs from the other appear, density fading rather than stopping abruptly, never a hard edge. Each transition zone follows a smooth, even course. Even inside a transition zone the skin is never left bare: at every point one pattern, or a mixture of the two, fully covers it. Pigment on living skin throughout, covering every inch of her body below the jaw with no bare skin anywhere, face unpainted.

Pose: both hands sweeping her hair back, every region clearly visible to the camera.

Footwear: platform stiletto heels, painted with the blended patterns following the same soft transitions as her skin.

Background & Lighting: the blended painted patterns reading crisp against her skin, the hard raking light carving every fold and curve.

Vertical 2:3 portrait-orientation full-body photograph, taller than it is wide. portrait 2:3 vertical.
